title: Cluster Attention Neural Operators for Solving Parametric Partial Differential Equations
abstract: arXiv:2609.39914v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Traditional simulations of parametric partial differential equations (PDEs) rely on repetitive computations for each parameter, which makes high-fidelity design impractical. Neural operators address this issue by learning solution operators, accelerating parameter-space mapping by orders of magnitude. Recent Transformer-based neural operators attempt to capture global dependencies, but often at the cost of quadratic attention complexity. Transolver resolves this problem by projecting physical states into a reduced slice space for attention computation. Although fast, this projection sacrifices fine spatial information. Moreover, by operating in this reduced space with shared weights across attention heads, it may constrain the model's flexibility, thereby limiting its capacity to capture complex phenomena. translated_title: 用于求解参数化偏微分方程的聚类注意力神经算子
translated_abstract: 传统的参数化偏微分方程（PDE）模拟需要对每个参数进行重复计算，这使得高保真度的设计难以实现。神经算子通过学习解算子来解决这一问题，将参数空间的映射速度提升了数个数量级。近来基于Transformer的神经算子试图捕捉全局依赖关系，但往往以二次方复杂度的注意力计算为代价。Transolver通过将物理状态投影到降维的切片空间中进行注意力计算来解决这一问题。尽管速度快，但这种投影牺牲了精细的空间信息。此外，由于在这种降维空间中运行且各注意力头之间共享权重，模型灵活性可能受到约束，从而限制了其捕捉复杂现象的能力。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了聚类注意力神经算子（CANO），它通过一种新颖的交叉注意力……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出聚类注意力神经算子（CANO），通过聚类方式重构注意力机制，在保持精细空间信息和模型灵活性的同时实现高效计算，从而更准确地求解参数化偏微分方程。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Cluster Attention Neural Operator (CANO), which reformulates attention through clustering to preserve fine spatial details and model flexibility while enabling efficient and accurate solution of parametric partial differential equations.
